name: Cable TV
description: Builds cable-style channels from your libraries, collections, playlists, genres, networks, decades and title lists on a deterministic schedule, publishes them to Live TV with logos and a guide, and exposes a schedule API for clients that tune in instantly by direct-playing at the right offset.
overview: Scheduled, always-on channels built from your library

versions.changelog: 0.4.0.0: channel suggestions from your library (networks, genres, decades, kids, holidays, collections), quick channels, lineup CSV and channel pack import/export, seasonal and pinned-episode imports, title, network, tag, rating, year and keyword sources with exclusions, channel logos (network logos, logo packs, generated), guide categories, and faster rebuilds for large libraries.
